Stoopid: In the Firefight phase, whenever you determine this
operative’s order, you cannot select Conceal. This operative
cannot perform any actions other than Charge, Dash, Fight,
Reposition and Shoot. It cannot use any weapons that aren’t

cards.text:
特种兵杀戮小队
原型：渗透，搜索与摧毁
特工
↘ 1 名特种兵头目强蛮人特工，装备有以下一
种选项:
• 短铳；大砍刀
• 短铳；动力爪
↘ 9 名特种兵特工，从以下列表进行选择:
• 炸弹跳跳 • 突突小子
• 小子 • 地精
• 破防小子 • 火箭小子
• 喷火小子 • 劈砍小子
• 通讯小子 • 狙击小子
除了小子特工以外，列表中的每一名特工只能被
纳入您的杀戮小队一次。
这些特工在选择时被视为半个选项，这意味着
您可以同时选择两者并被合计视为一个选择。
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDOS
KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPES: INFILTRATION, SEEK & DESTROY
OPERATIVES
↘ 1 KOMMANDO BOSS NOB operative with one
of the following options:
• Slugga; big choppa
• Slugga; power klaw
↘ 9 KOMMANDO operatives selected from the
following list:
• BOMB SQUIG • DAKKA BOY
• BOY • GROT
• BREACHA BOY • ROKKIT BOY
• BURNA BOY • SLASHA BOY
• COMMS BOY • SNIPA BOY
Other than BOY operatives, your kill team can
only include each operative on this list once.
These operatives count as half a selection each,
meaning you can select both of them and it’s
treated as one selection in total.

cards.text:
特种兵
阵营规则
割喉者
和其他欧克蛮人不同，特种兵们更倾向于用隐匿和
误导接近敌人，以便使用带齿利刃攻向敌人。
每一名己方特种兵特工（炸弹跳跳除外）都可以
在拥有隐匿命令时执行冲锋行动。
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
FACTION RULE
THROAT SLITTAS
Unusual amongst Orks, Kommandos utilise stealth and
misdirection to close in before falling upon the enemy
with jagged blades drawn.
Each friendly KOMMANDO operative (excluding
BOMB SQUIG) can perform the Charge action
while it has a Conceal order.

cards.text:
特种兵
战略计谋
突！突！突！
尽管特种兵们比起其他欧克蛮人更为狡诈，但
他们依然认为单靠倾泻大量火力便足以压制任
何目标。
己方特种兵特工的远程武器拥有“重击”武器规
则。
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
STRATEGY PLOY
DAKKA! DAKKA! DAKKA!
Whilst they are more subtle than other Orks,
Kommandos hold to the same belief that any target can
be overcome by simply applying a greater volume of fire.
Friendly KOMMANDO operatives’ ranged
weapons have the Punishing weapon rule.

cards.text:
特种兵
战略计谋
WAAAGH!
欧克蛮人那个臭名昭著的可怕战吼是血雨腥风
的征兆。
己方特种兵特工的近战武器获得“平衡”武器规
则。
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
STRATEGY PLOY
WAAAGH!
The infamous and dreaded battle cry of the Orks heralds
a tempest of violence and butchery.
Friendly KOMMANDO operatives’ melee
weapons have the Balanced weapon rule.

cards.text:
特种兵
战略计谋
游荡
这群鬼祟的特种兵比一般欧克蛮人更为狡诈，
能够利用掩护和地形悄然接近敌人。
每当一名敌方特工对拥有隐匿命令的己方特种兵
特工执行射击时，您无需掷骰便可以保留一枚防
御骰作为普通成功（本效果在掩护豁免之外额外生
效）。
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
STRATEGY PLOY
SKULK ABOUT
Kommandos exploit cover and terrain to confound the
enemy and confuse their aim.
Whenever an enemy operative is shooting a
friendly KOMMANDO operative that has a
Conceal order, you can retain one of your defence
dice as a normal success without rolling it (in
addition to a cover save, if any).

cards.text:
特种兵
战略计谋
嘘——！
尽管欧克蛮人特种兵体型硕大，但在需要时依
然可以在安静到出奇的情况下移动。
每一名不是敌方特工有效目标或拥有隐匿命令且
位于敌方特工 6" 外的己方特种兵特工可以立即
执行一次无消耗冲刺行动。该计谋不能在第一个转
折点中使用。
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
STRATEGY PLOY
SSSSHHHH!
Despite their colossal bulk, Ork Kommandos are capable
of moving surprisingly quietly, should the situation
demand it.
Each friendly KOMMANDO operative that’s
not a valid target for enemy operatives, or has a
Conceal order and is more than 6" from enemy
operatives, can immediately perform a free Dash
action. You cannot use this ploy during the first
turning point.

cards.text:
特种兵
交战计谋
擦伤罢了
欧克蛮人在受到足以令大多数其他生物伤残的
伤害时，依然能够保持活力。
在一名己方特种兵特工（炸弹跳跳和地精除
外）由于一枚攻击骰受到普通伤害时使用此交战
计谋。忽略那个伤害。
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
FIREFIGHT PLOY
JUST A SCRATCH
Orks have a remarkable ability to shrug off grievous
damage that would incapacitate most other species.
Use this firefight ploy when an attack dice
inflicts Normal Dmg on a friendly KOMMANDO
operative (excluding BOMB SQUIG and GROT).
Ignore that inflicted damage.

cards.text:
特种兵
交战计谋
碾碎他们！
尽管特种兵们比起一般欧克蛮人更为狡猾，但
他们依然渴望着战斗与杀戮。
在交战阶段结束时使用这个交战计谋。选择一名
己方特种兵特工，它可以立即执行一次无消耗
的近战行动。
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
FIREFIGHT PLOY
KRUMP ’EM!
Whilst they are far more crafty than your average Ork,
Kommandos are still ultimately driven by a need to fight
and kill.
Use this firefight ploy at the end of the Firefight
phase. Select one friendly KOMMANDO
operative. It can immediately perform a free
Fight action.

cards.text:
特种兵
交战计谋
狡诈而残暴
特种兵们倾向于通过狡猾的隐匿手段潜入敌
人之中，但这并不代表他们对残暴的热衷有
所衰减。
在拥有隐匿命令且在激活中执行了冲锋行动的
一名己方特种兵特工执行的近战中，您结算第
一枚攻击骰为出击的普通成功时使用这个交战计
谋。将那次普通成功替换为关键成功。
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
FIREFIGHT PLOY
KUNNIN’ BUT BRUTAL
Whilst they may utilise stealth and cunning to get
within range of their enemies, Kommandos are no less
enthusiastic about meting out brutal violence.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
KOMMANDO operative that has a Conceal
order is fighting during an activation in which it
performed the Charge action, you’re resolving the
first attack dice, and it’s a strike with a normal
success. Treat that normal success as a critical
success instead.

cards.text:
特种兵
交战计谋
轻松摆脱
欧克蛮人的特种兵们不仅天生拥有超强的适应
力，还披挂着各种土制护甲和防护装备，导致
他们的脚步很难被拖慢。
在一名己方特种兵特工激活或者其 APL 属性
被修正时使用这个交战计谋。直到下一个转折
点开始前，您可以忽略其 APL 属性受到的任意
修正。
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SHAKE IT OFF
Ork Kommandos bolster their natural resilience with
makeshift armour and protective equipment, rendering
their advance almost impossible to slow.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
KOMMANDO operative is activated, or when its
APL stat is changed. Until the start of the next
turning point, you can ignore any changes to its
APL stat.

cards.text:
特种兵
阵营装备
砍刀
欧克蛮人的大刀尽管做工粗糙且锈迹斑斑，不
过对于手起刀落造成的效果几乎没什么影响。
己方特种兵特工（炸弹跳跳和地精除外）获得
下列近战武器。请注意，一部分特工已经拥有了
这个武器且属性更佳，在这种情况下请使用属性
更佳的版本。
名称攻击命中伤害
砍刀 3 3+ 4/5
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
FACTION EQUIPMENT
CHOPPAS
Ork blades may appear crude and rusty, but this is
of little comfort to those on the receiving end of a
choppa blow.
Friendly KOMMANDO operatives (excluding
BOMB SQUIG and GROT) have the following
melee weapon. Note that some operatives already
have this weapon but with better stats; in that
instance, use the better version.
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Choppa 3 3+ 4/5

cards.text:
特种兵
阵营装备
炸药
特种兵以使用各种临时制作的爆炸物而闻名，
最常见的便是一捆极其不稳定的易爆炸药。
每场战斗限一次，一名己方特种兵特工（炸弹
跳跳和地精除外）可以使用下列远程武器：
名称攻击命中伤害
炸药 5 4+ 4/5
武器规则
范围 4"，爆炸 1"，重型 (仅限转移)，集中
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
FACTION EQUIPMENT
DYNAMITE
Kommandos are known to utilise a variety of improvised
explosives, the most common of which are bundles of
volatile dynamite.
Once per battle, a friendly KOMMANDO
operative (excluding BOMB SQUIG and GROT) can
use the following ranged weapon:
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Dynamite 5 4+ 4/5
WR
Range 4", Blast 1", Heavy (Reposition only),
Saturate

cards.text:
特种兵
阵营装备
鱼叉
这种武器发射出的尖锐投射物能钉住任何还没
被其杀死的敌人，使其寸步难行。
每个转折点限一次，一名己方特种兵特工（炸
弹跳跳和地精除外）可以使用下列远程武器：
名称攻击命中伤害
鱼叉 4 4+ 4/5
武器规则
范围 8"，致命5+，晕眩
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
FACTION EQUIPMENT
HARPOON
This weapon fires a sharp, barbed projectile that
snags any foes it doesn’t kill outright, preventing them
from moving.
Once per turning point, a friendly KOMMANDO
operative (excluding BOMB SQUIG and GROT) can
use the following ranged weapon:
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Harpoon 4 4+ 4/5
WR
Range 8", Lethal 5+, Stun

cards.text:
特种兵
阵营装备
折叠枪托
特种兵常常使用被裁短或换装折叠枪托的改装
枪支以增强火力。
移除下列远程武器的“范围”武器规则：
• 震荡手枪
• 短铳
cards.text_en:
KOMMANDO
FACTION EQUIPMENT
COLLAPSIBLE STOCKS
Kommandos often use modified guns with cut down
or folding shoulder stocks to enhance the impact of
their firepower.
Remove the Range weapon rule from the
following ranged weapons friendly KOMMANDO
operatives have:
• Shokka pistol
• Slugga
